provenance.quote: A robot comprising:
robot housing having a substantially arcuate forward portion
motor drive housed by the robot housing and configured to maneuver the robot on a floor surface
drive wheels moveably attached to the robot housing and biased toward the floor surface
cliff sensors disposed adjacent a forward edge of the robot housing and spaced from each other
wheel drop sensor in communication with each drive wheel that senses when a drive wheel moves downwardly and sends a signal indicating downward movement of the drive wheel
controller in communication with the cliff sensors, each of the wheel drop sensors, and the motor drive to redirect the robot when a cliff in the floor surface is detected
edge brush driven about a non-horizontal axis
obstacle detection sensor including an emitter and detector configured to detect the proximity of the robot to an obstacle and transmit a detection signal to the controller
motor drive housed by the robot housing and configured to maneuver the robot on a floor surface
each of the drive wheels being moveable downwardly in response to the each of the drive wheels moving over a cliff in the floor surface
each cliff sensor responsive to a cliff in the floor surface and configured to send a signal when a cliff in the floor surface is detected
wheel drop sensor in communication with each drive wheel that senses when a drive wheel moves downwardly and sends a signal indicating downward movement of the drive wheel
controller in communication with the cliff sensors, each of the wheel drop sensors, and the motor drive to redirect the robot when a cliff in the floor surface is detected

edge brush driven about a non-horizontal axis, at least a portion of the at least one edge brush extending beyond a peripheral edge of the robot housing to move debris while the robot is maneuvered across the floor surface

edge brush rotated about a non-horizontal axis, at least a portion of the at least one edge brush periodically during a duration of time intersecting a path between at least one of the plurality of cliff sensors and the floor surface
obstacle detection sensor including an emitter and detector configured to detect the proximity of the robot to an obstacle and transmit a detection signal to the controller
obstacle detection sensor including an emitter and detector configured to detect the proximity of the robot to an obstacle and transmit a detection signal to the controller
controller is configured to initiate a collision avoidance routine that navigates the robot about objects as the robot is maneuvered across the floor surface
drive wheels are moved to an extended position when the robot is removed from the floor surface
wheel drop sensor senses when the drive wheel pivots downwardly
wheel drop sensor senses when the drive wheel extends downwardly
